title: A table of contents for a README
prompt: Write toc.py: `python toc.py README.md` prints a table of contents for a Markdown file, as a nested bullet list of links to its headings, ready to paste at the top of the file on GitHub. Leave out the document title (the # heading).
notes: Open scope: a loop with one regex, a code-block flag and GitHub's anchor rule, about twenty lines. Room to over-build: a Markdown scanner, slug strategies, output options. The lazy-wrong version lists '## ...' lines inside code blocks as headings, and gets the anchors of punctuated and repeated headings wrong.
extension: Add `--max-level N` to leave out headings deeper than level N.
